heading: Clearer OpenSSH connection setup
summary: See the alias name and resolved connection values directly in the form, with each value ready to edit.
changes: The connection name appears above the destination and defaults to the selected OpenSSH alias.
Hostname or IP, user, port, and identity are filled into their fields instead of gray placeholders. The alias remains active for alias-specific SSH rules.
Choose Use address to replace the alias destination with its resolved hostname or IP.
notice: Close active sessions before updating. Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon.
